episodes.recap_text: J. Robert Oppenheimer navigates European quantum physics breakthroughs and returns to America.
episodes.teaser_next: A remote desert mesa in New Mexico becomes the focal point of the secret atomic laboratory.

episodes.break_rationale: Ends on the eve of the Trinity test countdown; maximum suspense pause.
episodes.recap_text: Scientists gather at Los Alamos while security forces heighten surveillance on Robert's personal past.

episodes.break_rationale: Ends in the silent blastwave shock of the detonation; world altered forever.

episodes.title: The Chain Reaction
